reviews.text: Newbie. Day one but happy to be finally doing this. It seems very achievable.

Mostly Great. After 3 weeks I’m tighter but not what was promised (not that I expected THAT! I’m not a fool) I feel a lot better physically and am really enjoying it. I’ve commented a couple of times after sessions that there are too many ‘ankle circles’ (in and out) which I find to be a waste and consider to be filler in the 20 minute sessions. Also, if you don’t have a chair of very similar proportions to the one in the videos, some of the exercises will be awkward and/or difficult, I.e. sitting lunges. That being said, go for it. It’s a great way to start getting back into shape and as soon as I get the all clear from my PCP I’m going to slowly add in that aerobic exercise I need to take off the 20lbs I’ve inexplicably put on in the last couple of years, as well as some weight training for more strengthening. But I will continue my chair yoga. It’s a nice start to my day.

Needs just a couple important additions for 5 stars. I just completed my 1st exercise and am in love. FINALLY found a reasonable exercise program that I can do in my small crowded space. And I feel it. While it seems the impact may be too little while sitting in a chair, I felt it and feel like I did work out. It was gentle yet powerful. 

Now for what I think will make it close to perfect. 1) I first downloaded it to phone and set up my program. Small screen. I want to send via AirPlay to my TV for better viewing. No can do. Would love that capability as us even the youngest seniors of us have vision challenges even with glasses on a small screen. 2) as a result, I downloaded the app to my iPad for better viewing. But there was no option to log in using the same account so that I could use the app on my device of choice. The app only allowed me to set up another profile and start with a new account. 3) There seems to be a bug with the voice and video syncing with the timer. “15 seconds left” was given at the 10-12 seconds point. (Yes, it varied.) Sometimes the video started showing the next exercise with 3-5 seconds left before “rest” transition. I didn’t always get the three beeps and a ding at the end of an exercise. Hopefully this can be resolved because I am not usually staring at the screen throughout the exercise. 

These issues aren’t deal breakers. But if resolved would bring my review to 5 stars. Oh, and the ability to sync with an appleTV app would just put me over the moon.
